cards.question: What does Send mean?
cards.answer: A type T is Send if its ownership can be transferred to another thread.

cards.question: What does Sync mean?
cards.answer: A type T is Sync if its shared reference is Send; that is, T is Sync if &T is Send.

cards.question: Which primitive types are Send and Sync?
cards.answer: All primitive types are Send and Sync.

cards.question: When are types automatically Send and Sync?
cards.answer: When all of their fields are Send and Sync.
